# Data contract evolution

A downstream analyst needs historical and incremental data after an amount-field rename. Normalize both forms and block missing required values.

## Input and contract
input/fixture.json; input/dictionary.md; project version 1

## Finding and reproducible output
```json
{
  "rows": [
    {
      "id": "H1",
      "cents": 1200,
      "origin": "v1"
    },
    {
      "id": "N1",
      "cents": 801,
      "origin": "v2"
    },
    {
      "id": "N2",
      "cents": 999,
      "origin": "v1"
    }
  ],
  "missing": [],
  "publish": true
}
```

## Failure prevented
Using only the new field loses historical amounts.

## Decision and limits
Accept only the specified result set. Escalate a missing identity, permission, business probe or required not-run item. This is an original synthetic teaching reference, not evidence of learner execution or real employment.

files.query.sql: SELECT id,amount_cents AS cents,'v1' AS origin FROM history UNION ALL SELECT id,COALESCE(cents,amount_cents) AS cents,CASE WHEN cents IS NULL THEN 'v1' ELSE 'v2' END AS origin FROM increment ORDER BY id;
